families.decision: Organic fresh egg pasta with whole-grain flour and a named egg source.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and a small maker's name on the chilled pack.
Read the flour line for whole grain or sprouted whole grain.
Look for pasture-raised eggs in the ingredient or sourcing statement.
Check the sealed pack's use-by date and keep-refrigerated instructions.

families.decision: Organic pasture-raised prepared meat from a named farm, with a short recipe.
buying_tips: Look for organic and pasture-raised wording with a named family farm.
Look for AGA grassfed or 100% grass-fed and grass-finished wording on beef.
Read every meat, fat and seasoning ingredient, including sublists.
Skip ingredient lists with added smoke flavor, MSG or unspecified oil blends.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough with starter fermentation stated on the pack.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and whole-grain flour in the ingredient list.
Read the pack for starter fermentation or a stated fermentation time.
Pick a small baker named on the pack, with the grain or mill source listed.
Skip sourdough flavoring and acid-only recipes without starter fermentation.

families.decision: Organic potato fries with no added oil, or with clearly named tallow or lard.
buying_tips: Look for organic potatoes and a named grower or independent maker.
Read every listed oil, including the coating and seasoning sublists.
Pick potatoes alone, or potatoes with tallow or lard and optional salt.
Skip listed vegetable-oil blends, sugar and starch-based coatings.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain waffles with fermented batter and butter.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and whole grain as the first listed flour.
Read the pack for sourdough fermentation, soaking or sprouted whole grains.
Read every fat ingredient for butter, ghee or coconut oil.
Pick a plain recipe from a named small baker; skip filled or iced versions.

families.decision: Organic pasture-raised poultry or pork from a named family farm.
buying_tips: Look for organic and pasture-raised wording on the actual meat pack.
Check the label for a family farm's name and location.
Read any coating, seasoning and cooking-oil ingredient sublists.
Skip packs listing unspecified oil blends, added flavors or protein isolates.

families.decision: Organic cocoa foods with a short ingredient list and traceable cacao.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification on the selected cocoa product.
Check the pack for a small maker and the cacao's farm, co-op or origin.
Look for dated lead and cadmium results matching the pack's product and lot.
Skip ingredient lists with lecithin, flavorings or non-cocoa added fats.

families.decision: Organic sweeteners with the source plant and process named on the label.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and the actual sweetener named as an ingredient.
Check the label for a small producer, growing region and lot.
Read the process wording for raw, whole-cane or unrefined, as appropriate.
Skip syrup blends, added flavorings and artificial sweeteners on the list.

families.decision: Plain organic flour or meal with its grain, nut or root clearly named.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and a named grain, nut or root ingredient.
Read grain labels for whole grain or sprouted whole grain.
Check for a recent milling date and a small farm or mill named on the bag.
Skip grain flour labeled refined, enriched or degerminated.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain baking with sprouting, soaking or fermentation disclosed.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and whole grain in every flour ingredient.
Read the pack for sprouting, soaking or starter fermentation.
Pick a small baker's named recipe with butter, olive oil or coconut oil.
Skip enriched-flour-led lists, added gluten and unspecified oil blends.

families.decision: Plain organic whole grains from an identified grower or harvest region.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and the grain's name on the bag.
Read the ingredient list for the grain alone.
Check for a named small grower, harvest region and crop or packing date.
Skip flavored mixes and damp, torn or insect-damaged packs.

families.decision: Plain organic dried pulses with a named grower and a single ingredient.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification; prefer an added Real Organic seal.
Read the ingredient list for beans, peas or lentils alone.
Check the bag for a small grower's name, origin and crop or lot.
Skip seasoning packets and bags with damp clumps or visible insects.

families.decision: Organic fruit preparations made from the named fruit, without added sweetener.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and a named orchard or small producer.
Read the ingredient list for fruit alone, or fruit with water.
Skip added sugar, syrups, sweetening concentrates and flavorings on the list.
Check that the jar or pouch is sealed and the fruit origin is stated.

families.decision: Organic dressings and salads with extra virgin olive oil or plain cultured dairy.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and a small maker named on the bottle or tub.
Read every oil, mayonnaise and dairy sublist, including the dressing on salads.
Pick extra virgin olive oil or plain cultured dairy as the base.
Skip soybean, canola and corn oil, EDTA and added flavors on the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic fermented sauces with live, unpasteurised and refrigerated wording.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and a named small sauce maker.
Read the pack for fermented, live and unpasteurised wording.
Check for keep-refrigerated instructions and a chilled display.
Skip corn syrup, smoke flavoring and unspecified vegetable oils in the recipe.

families.decision: Organic pesto with extra virgin olive oil as its only added oil.
buying_tips: Look for organic certification and a named small maker or herb farm.
Read the complete oil list for extra virgin olive oil alone.
Check that every herb, nut, seed and cheese ingredient is named.
Skip sunflower, canola or soybean oil, starch fillers and added flavors.

fresh_pasta.decision: Organic fresh egg pasta with whole-grain flour and pasture-raised eggs.
fresh_pasta.delta: Plain ribbons have no filling; filled pasta needs a separate filling ingredient list.

deli.decision: Organic pasture-raised whole-roast deli meat from a named farm.
deli.delta: A whole roast or salt-cured loin sliced at the counter; skip formed meat loaf wording.

frozen_pizza.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough pizza with olive oil and real mozzarella.
frozen_pizza.delta: Tomato sauce and real mozzarella on the topping list; olive oil in the crust ingredients.

frozen_meals.decision: Organic frozen stew with pasture-raised meat, vegetables and bone broth.
frozen_meals.delta: Meat and vegetables lead the recipe; bone broth is named in the sauce ingredients.

frozen_fries.decision: Organic frozen potato strips with no added oil, or with tallow.
frozen_fries.delta: Skin-on potato strips; skip reconstituted potato shapes.

frozen_waffles.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough waffles made with butter.
frozen_waffles.delta: Eggs and plain yogurt or buttermilk in the batter; a plain waffle without syrup filling.

frozen_nuggets.decision: Organic pasture-raised chicken nuggets made from whole chicken pieces.
frozen_nuggets.delta: Whole chicken pieces or whole-muscle tenders on the pack; a simple flour coating.

frozen.decision: Plain organic frozen fruit and vegetables, with produce alone on the ingredient list.
frozen.delta: Freezer-case packs sealed and frozen solid.

dark_chocolate.decision: Organic dark chocolate with a short cacao recipe and dated lead/cadmium results.
dark_chocolate.delta: Plain solid bars; cacao with a named sweetener and optional cocoa butter.

molasses_whole_cane_sweeteners.decision: Organic unsulphured molasses or dried whole cane juice.
molasses_whole_cane_sweeteners.delta: Unsulphured on liquid molasses; dried whole cane juice on granules.

baking_powder.decision: Aluminum-free baking powder with organic starch.
baking_powder.delta: Cream of tartar or monocalcium phosphate; skip sodium aluminum sulfate or sodium aluminum phosphate.

cornmeal_polenta_grits.decision: Organic whole-grain cornmeal, polenta or grits from a named small mill.
cornmeal_polenta_grits.delta: Germ and bran retained on the label; fine cornmeal or coarse polenta and grits.

rice_cakes_puffed_grains.decision: Pick organic fermented whole-grain crackers in place of puffed rice cakes.
rice_cakes_puffed_grains.delta: Puffed or extruded rice cakes are the form to skip.

wild_rice.decision: Certified organic, hand-harvested lake or river wild rice.
wild_rice.delta: Hand-harvested lake or river origin stated on the pack; wild rice alone, without a rice blend.

split_peas.decision: Organic dried split peas, peas alone, with the grower's name.
split_peas.delta: Husked, split halves are the intended pea form.

applesauce.decision: Organic unsweetened applesauce with apples alone on the ingredient list.
applesauce.delta: Smooth or chunky texture on the jar; cinnamon should be a named spice.

salad_dressing.decision: Organic extra virgin olive oil dressing with vinegar or lemon and herbs.
salad_dressing.delta: Vinaigrette uses vinegar or lemon; creamy versions name plain yogurt or cultured cream.

bbq_sauce_marinades.decision: Organic live fermented BBQ sauce or marinade, unpasteurised and refrigerated.
bbq_sauce_marinades.delta: BBQ sauce names tomato and molasses; smoked paprika supplies the smoky seasoning.

pesto.decision: Organic basil pesto with extra virgin olive oil and raw-milk cheese where legally sold.
pesto.delta: Basil, pine nuts, Parmesan, garlic and salt; named walnut or seed versions are alternatives.
